title: Jagged Earthy Norwegian Reblochon Dumplings
description: A light and earthy Norwegian dish featuring reblochon cheese, these dumplings are paleo-friendly and have a shattering texture, with a mix of earthy mushrooms and fresh herbs. They are perfect for a dinner or lunch option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix the crumbled reblochon cheese, chopped parsley, and earthy mushrooms.
Add the egg to the cheese mixture and mix until well combined.
Slowly add the dry ingredients to the cheese mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into dumplings.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the dumplings.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
